Masses to the nearest kg, class 50–54: boundaries 49.5 and 54.5, width 5.
Age in completed years 20–29: boundaries 20 and 30 (ages are truncated, not rounded).
Plot running totals at UPPER class boundaries, starting from zero at the lowest boundary.
Median at $\frac{n}{2}$, $Q_1$ at $\frac{n}{4}$, $Q_3$ at $\frac{3n}{4}$, $k$th percentile at $\frac{k}{100}n$.

The class with the greatest frequency density (tallest bar), not necessarily the greatest frequency.
